cases.source: const d=new Date(0);if(!d.toString().startsWith("Thu Jan 01 1970 08:00:00 GMT+0800")||d.toDateString()!=="Thu Jan 01 1970"||!d.toTimeString().startsWith("08:00:00 GMT+0800"))throw 1;if(Date.parse(d.toString())!==0||new Date(d.toString()).getTime()!==0)throw 2;

const d=new Date(946684800000);if(!d.toString().startsWith("Sat Jan 01 2000 08:00:00 GMT+0800")||d.toDateString()!=="Sat Jan 01 2000"||!d.toTimeString().startsWith("08:00:00 GMT+0800"))throw 1;if(Date.parse(d.toString())!==946684800000||new Date(d.toString()).getTime()!==946684800000)throw 2;

const d=new Date(1720000000000);if(!d.toString().startsWith("Wed Jul 03 2024 17:46:40 GMT+0800")||d.toDateString()!=="Wed Jul 03 2024"||!d.toTimeString().startsWith("17:46:40 GMT+0800"))throw 1;if(Date.parse(d.toString())!==1720000000000||new Date(d.toString()).getTime()!==1720000000000)throw 2;

const before=Date.now(),text=Date({toString(){throw 1;}}),after=Date.now();if(typeof text!=="string")throw 2;const t=Date.parse(text);if(t<Math.floor(before/1000)*1000||t>after)throw 3;if(new Date(NaN).toDateString()!=="Invalid Date"||new Date(NaN).toTimeString()!=="Invalid Date")throw 4;
